title: Ensure correct HDR resource state transitions before Composite
motivation: HDR is written as UAV by DXR/compute and then sampled as SRV by the Composite. We currently only insert a UAV barrier, which enforces ordering but not state. Insert explicit transitions to SRV before Composite (and back to UAV if needed).
deliverables: After all UAV writes to HDR, transition HDR: UAV → PIX-safe SRV read
Before next frame's UAV writes, transition HDR back to UAV (if not re-created)
Backbuffer transitions remain PRESENT→RTV→PRESENT around Composite
acceptance: PIX shows HDR in SRV state during Composite draw
No warnings about incorrect resource state usage
implementation: Replace the current UAV barrier with: a UAV barrier followed by a TRANSITION from D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS to D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE | D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE
Optionally transition back to UAV after present, or at start of next frame before writes
test_plan: Run with PIX; validate resource states in Event Details
Enable debug layer; check for absence of resource state warnings
